author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at Sony again as somehow we're not just losing the physical games but also the developers that have build the brand up for over 25 years. We've even reached a point where suing the customer for opinions is now something this once great company has stopped down to. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
